dropped.finding: No test exercises a PARTIAL graph-cache hit (some ids warm, some cold) within a single summary_many call. The lazy memoised loader (`if not loaded: loaded.append(...)`) is the mechanism that guarantees the store is reduced at most once even when only some ids miss the cache — the exact '3 ids, every new id missed the cache' scenario the bug describes — yet the tests only cover all-cold (3 cold -> 1 pass) and all-warm (3 warm -> 0 passes). A regression that reloaded the store per cold id would still pass all three store-pass tests.
dropped.suggested_fix: Add a test that calls gates.summary_many([BLOCKED], tracker) to warm the cache for BLOCKED, then starts _count_store_passes and calls gates.summary_many([BLOCKED, READY, UNBLOCKED], tracker), asserting len(calls) == 1 (the two cold ids share the single memoised load, the warm id triggers none).
